title: yongle-mural-annotation-tools: browser-based IAA and annotation-workflow tools for Yongle Palace mural patches
description: Browser-based research tools for Yongle Palace Taoist mural patch annotation, including a standalone inter-annotator agreement toolkit and a local annotation workflow console. This release contains no API keys and is intended for local use rather than hosted deployment.
notes: Public repository: https://github.com/lbiceice/yongle-mural-annotation-tools. Release v1.0.0 software DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20429891. The workflow console is designed for local use with user-supplied credentials and local helper endpoints.
